Sure you can sign up and then go in and cancel, but this reeks or preying on your customers and I won’t support it.

reviews.title: DISGRACEFUL CUSTOMER SUPPORT
reviews.text: I messaged this company on their “support” email bc I was charged for the subscription and I hadn’t used the app since I got it two years ago…so of course I went and checked my account on their app so I could cancel it if I it was active and it said I didn’t have an active subscription so I was a little irritated bc why am I getting charged for the subscription if I don’t have one active??  So I emailed them asking for my money back the same morning I was charged as soon as I woke up and saw it. It was 7 in the morning. The only answer I got was an automated email saying they received my email and they would get back to me so I waited. On Wednesday I still hadn’t received an answer so I messaged them again stating that I still hadn’t received a response and I still wanted my money back and for them to remove my card from their system. It’s Saturday and still NO RESPONSE. So I went and did a lot of digging and researching to find out how to cancel the subscription and finally found it and canceled it and it wasn’t on the app but it took me forever to find it when all they had to do was help me but no they ignored me completely!!! Do not get a subscription on this app!! They won’t help you cancel it and they will charge you behind your back and then make you jump through hoops to cancel it with no help from them!!!! If I could attach pictures I would to show my account said no active subscription! And the charge.

reviews.title: New redesign ruining a brilliant app
reviews.text:
This app has been one of my favourite apps ever, and I was happy to pay a not inconsiderable amount for it when I bought it in 2025. I run a microbakery business from home and have used ReciMe for both my personal and professional cooking and baking on almost a daily basis. 
However the latest update and redesign rolled out a few days ago is appalling. 
Functionality of recipe reading and saving is still there but readability is massively compromised. The whole user experience now feels incredibly cheap and tacky. It sounds dramatic to say it but I actually considered uninstalling it, I was so frustrated by the graphics and clunky visuals. If this had been 2008 and the app’s first iteration, I’d have been applauding, but it isn’t. It now looks like the kind of project a 10 year old would create in a school coding club.
I really hope some other choices are made in the next iteration in response to user feedback. Please do better, ReciMe.
